config.label: Outbox API key (Bearer `outbox_*`)
config.description: Outbox API key (Bearer `outbox_*`). Without it (or the CLI's ~/.outboxrc) the server still starts and every tool asks you to configure it.

config.label: Owner username used as the default `user` argument, skipping a call to /api/me (optional)
config.description: Owner username used as the default `user` argument, skipping a call to /api/me (optional).

config.label: Alternative path to the CLI credential file (default ~/
config.description: Alternative path to the CLI credential file (default ~/.outboxrc).

config.label: API base URL (everything, including content reads)
config.description: API base URL (everything, including content reads). Default https://api.out-box.dev.

config.label: Public site base URL, only used to build the link shown to the human
config.description: Public site base URL, only used to build the link shown to the human. Default https://out-box.dev.

config.label: Toolsets to register: core, comments, library, sharing, keys, teams, automation, apps or all
config.description: Toolsets to register: core, comments, library, sharing, keys, teams, automation, apps or all. Default core,comments,sharing.

config.label: Folder where the MCP reads/writes files via file_path (nothing outside it)
config.description: Folder where the MCP reads/writes files via file_path (nothing outside it). Default ~/Outbox.
